credentials.title: AI credentials
credentials.exists: An OpenAI key is configured ({{source}}). Leave blank to keep it. LM Studio authentication uses the token secret file on the server.
credentials.description: An OpenAI key is stored on the server separately from settings. LM Studio authentication uses the token secret file on the server.
credentials.choose: Either enter a key or remove the saved key.
